# Wald-Q4B v2

> Open-weight 4B decision model. Given a state and typed questions (choice, yes/no, score), it returns a calibrated probability for every option through a Jev-compatible `POST /v1/systemone` API. v2 (revision `v2.0`, checkpoint `04701-c22`) starts from Qwen3.5-4B (chat) and thinks natively when unsure (Auto 0.7). Apache-2.0 weights and serving code; self-hosted with vLLM on one NVIDIA GPU.
